settings.question: Will the new screen look factory fitted?
settings.answer: That is the aim. We use screens made for your model, so they sit in the original dash position and match the trim.

settings.question: Do I keep my iDrive, MMI or steering wheel controls?
settings.answer: In most cases, yes. We choose screens that work with your car's original controls and reversing camera. If anything can't be kept, we tell you before you book.

settings.question: How much does a screen upgrade cost?
settings.answer: It depends on your car and the screen size, so we price it from your reg. You get one fixed fitted price before you book.

settings.question: How long does it take?
settings.answer: Most screen upgrades are done the same day. We confirm the time when you book.

settings.heading: Screen upgrade questions
settings.text: What drivers ask us before booking.

settings.title: A bigger screen that fits your dash
settings.content: Older factory screens are small and slow. An upgrade gives you a modern widescreen with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto built in, fitted so it looks like it left the factory that way. We specialise in BMW and Mercedes-Benz, and upgrade Audi and Volkswagen too.

settings.heading: Visit the workshop
settings.text: Drop in to see screens and speakers working, or bring your car for a fitting.
